title: Trove home device event
description: One line of home/<source>/events/YYYY-MM.jsonl: a discrete device event (lock/unlock, motion, doorbell, vacuum run, light on/off, voice command). Additive evolution: readers tolerate unknown fields.

ts.description: RFC3339 local time of the event

source.description: collector id; identical to the source folder name (lowercase/digits/dash)

device.description: device id or name the event came from

event.description: what happened, lower-case verb/noun: unlock, lock, motion, doorbell, run, on, off, command, open, close, leak, …

value.description: a numeric payload where one fits (brightness after on, area cleaned)

detail.description: free-form payload: the method ("keypad"), the cleaned area, the transcribed Alexa command

who.description: raw handle of who triggered it (keypad code id, account handle) — never resolved to a person

who_name.description: display name for who, if the source gives one

guid.description: source-unique event id, the dedupe key

extra.description: everything source-specific (response text, event subtype, clip URL, …)
